subject.title: fix(scripts): add curl --connect-timeout to install scripts

question: Should the public installers adopt a 10-second curl-only connection budget, or preserve the existing 20-second connection tolerance used by wget?
rationale: This changes first-time setup behavior for slow DNS, proxy, VPN, and TLS paths, so the acceptable failure threshold is a product and compatibility policy rather than a purely mechanical curl choice.

options.title: Align at 20 seconds
options.body: Use the existing wget timeout as the shared curl connection budget and require real installer-path proof for timeout and successful download behavior.

options.title: Accept 10 seconds
options.body: Keep the stricter curl threshold only with explicit maintainer acceptance of the curl/wget asymmetry and proof from representative slow proxy or handshake conditions.

recommendation.title: Align at 20 seconds
recommendation.body: Use the existing wget timeout as the shared curl connection budget and require real installer-path proof for timeout and successful download behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes the documented public installation entry points and their failure policy.
